content.title: KAI Q2 Deep Dive: Aftermarket Demand, Capital Bookings, and Tariff Volatility Shape Outlook
content.summary: Industrial equipment manufacturer Kadant (NYSE:KAI) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2025, but sales fell by 7.1% year on year to $255.3 million. Revenue guidance for the full year exceeded analysts’ estimates, but next quarter’s guidance of $259.5 million was less impressive, coming in 4.2% below expectations. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.31 per share was 18.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
